provenance.scope: Controlled retrieval-policy comparison; not a real-world recruitment quality estimate.

metric_definitions.precision_at_n: Relevant, hard-condition-compliant returned matches divided by returned matches (not padded to the target); null when no matches.
metric_definitions.relevant_recall: Correct returned identities divided by relevant confirmed identities reachable in at least one nonblocked source snapshot.
metric_definitions.citation_correctness: Exact excerpt presence in the referenced original document only; this does not measure semantic entailment or claim correctness.
metric_definitions.target_success: At least the requested count of relevant, compliant identities returned with zero hard-condition violations.
metric_definitions.direction_coverage: Confirmed requested directions represented by correct returned matches divided by requested directions.

comparison: Same production agent loop, assessment service, source snapshots, model, 12-decision and candidate budgets; isolated providers, catalog and caches. Fixed control searches two predetermined pages and never enriches details. Adaptive live arm uses native model tool decisions.
